verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page claims nearly word-for-word that all the packages, tools and runtimes a developer might need are up to date and ready with a single command. Supporting docs mention package management and container tooling, and one community user reports quickly turning Fedora into a full Python development workstation. missing for 10: documentation naming the actual command or mechanism and what it installs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the single-command setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full set of packages, tools, and runtimes ready to use with a single command

citations.quote: All the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command.
